wikidot5e:spell:summon-beast.effectSummary: Summon a Small Bestial Spirit in a visible unoccupied space within 90 feet for up to 1 hour, choosing Air, Land, or Water. It is your ally, shares your initiative and acts immediately after you, obeys verbal commands without your action, and otherwise Dodges and avoids danger. AC is 11 + spell level; HP 20 for Air or 30 for Land/Water, plus 5 per spell level above 2nd; speed 30 ft., with climb 30 Land, fly 60 Air, or swim 30 Water; Str 18, Dex 11, Con 16, Int 4, Wis 14, Cha 5; darkvision 60 ft.; understands your languages. Air has Flyby; Land and Water have Pack Tactics; Water can breathe only underwater. It makes a number of Maul attacks equal to half the spell level rounded down, using your spell attack modifier for 1d8 + 4 + spell level piercing damage. Higher-level slots scale spell-level statistics.

wikidot5e:spell:summon-celestial.effectSummary: Summon a Large Celestial Spirit in a visible unoccupied space within 90 feet for up to 1 hour, choosing Avenger or Defender. It is your ally, shares your initiative and acts immediately after you, obeys verbal commands without your action, and otherwise Dodges and avoids danger. AC is 11 + spell level, plus 2 for Defender; HP 40 + 10 per spell level above 5th; speed 30 ft., fly 40 ft.; Str 16, Dex 14, Con 16, Int 10, Wis 14, Cha 16; radiant resistance; immune to charmed and frightened; darkvision 60 ft.; speaks Celestial and understands your languages. It makes a number of attacks equal to half the spell level rounded down. Avenger's Radiant Bow is a 150/600 ranged attack for 2d6 + 2 + spell level radiant; Defender's Radiant Mace is a melee attack for 1d10 + 3 + spell level radiant and grants 1d10 temporary HP to itself or a creature within 10 feet of the target. Once per day Healing Touch restores 2d8 + spell level HP to another creature. Higher-level slots scale spell-level statistics.

wikidot5e:spell:summon-construct.effectSummary: Summon a Medium Construct Spirit in a visible unoccupied space within 90 feet for up to 1 hour, choosing Clay, Metal, or Stone. It is your ally, shares your initiative and acts immediately after you, obeys verbal commands without your action, and otherwise Dodges and avoids danger. AC is 13 + spell level; HP 40 + 15 per spell level above 4th; speed 30 ft.; Str 18, Dex 10, Con 18, Int 14, Wis 11, Cha 5; poison resistance; immune to charmed, exhaustion, frightened, incapacitated, paralyzed, petrified, and poisoned; darkvision 60 ft.; understands your languages. Metal's Heated Body deals 1d10 fire to creatures that touch it or hit it with a melee attack from within 5 feet. Stone's Stony Lethargy can force a creature starting within 10 feet to make a Wisdom save or lose reactions and halve its speed until its next turn. Clay's Berserk Lashing reaction makes a Slam against a random adjacent creature when damaged, or moves half speed toward a visible enemy without provoking if none is adjacent. It makes half the spell level rounded down Slam attacks for 1d8 + 4 + spell level bludgeoning. Higher-level slots scale spell-level statistics.

wikidot5e:spell:summon-draconic-spirit.effectSummary: Summon a Large neutral Draconic Spirit in a visible unoccupied space within 60 feet for up to 1 hour, choosing Chromatic, Gem, or Metallic. It is your ally, shares your initiative and acts immediately after you, obeys verbal commands without your action, and otherwise Dodges and avoids danger. AC is 14 + spell level; HP 50 + 10 per spell level above 5th; speed 30 ft., fly 60 ft., swim 30 ft.; Str 19, Dex 14, Con 17, Int 10, Wis 14, Cha 14; Chromatic/Metallic resist acid, cold, fire, lightning, and poison, while Gem resists force, necrotic, psychic, radiant, and thunder; immune to charmed, frightened, and poisoned; blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft.; speaks Draconic and understands your languages. Choose one of its resistances when summoned; you gain that resistance for the spell's duration. Each turn it makes half the spell level rounded down Rend attacks for 1d6 + 4 + spell level piercing and uses a 30-foot-cone Breath Weapon dealing 2d6 of one of its resisted damage types, Dexterity save for half. Higher-level slots scale spell-level statistics.

wikidot5e:spell:summon-draconic-spirit-u.effectSummary: Summon a Large Draconic Spirit in a visible unoccupied space within 60 feet for up to 1 hour, choosing Chromatic, Gem, or Metallic. It is your ally, shares your initiative and acts immediately after you, obeys verbal commands without your action, and otherwise Dodges and avoids danger. AC is 14 + spell level; HP 50 + 10 per spell level above 5th; speed 30 ft., fly 80 ft., swim 30 ft.; Str 19, Dex 14, Con 17, Int 10, Wis 14, Cha 14; Chromatic/Metallic resist acid, cold, fire, lightning, and poison, while Gem resists force, necrotic, psychic, radiant, and thunder; immune to charmed, frightened, and poisoned; blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft.; speaks Draconic and understands your languages. Choose one of its resistances when summoned; you gain that resistance for the duration. Each turn it uses Breath Weapon and makes half the spell level rounded down Bite and Claw attacks for 1d6 + 4 + spell level piercing; Breath Weapon is a 30-foot cone dealing 2d6 of one resisted damage type, Dexterity save for half. Higher-level slots scale spell-level statistics.

wikidot5e:spell:summon-elemental.effectSummary: Summon a Medium Elemental Spirit in a visible unoccupied space within 90 feet for up to 1 hour, choosing Air, Earth, Fire, or Water. It is your ally, shares your initiative and acts immediately after you, obeys verbal commands without your action, and otherwise Dodges and avoids danger. AC is 11 + spell level; HP 50 + 10 per spell level above 4th; speed 40 ft., plus burrow 40 Earth, hovering fly 40 Air, or swim 40 Water; Str 18, Dex 15, Con 17, Int 4, Wis 10, Cha 16. Water resists acid, Air resists lightning and thunder, Earth resists piercing and slashing; all are immune to poison and Fire is also immune to fire. It is immune to exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, and unconscious, has darkvision 60 ft., and understands your languages. Air, Fire, and Water can squeeze through 1-inch spaces. It makes half the spell level rounded down Slam attacks for 1d10 + 4 + spell level bludgeoning, or fire for Fire. Higher-level slots scale spell-level statistics.

wikidot5e:spell:summon-fey.effectSummary: Summon a Small Fey Spirit in a visible unoccupied space within 90 feet for up to 1 hour, choosing Fuming, Mirthful, or Tricksy. It is your ally, shares your initiative and acts immediately after you, obeys verbal commands without your action, and otherwise Dodges and avoids danger. AC is 12 + spell level; HP 30 + 10 per spell level above 3rd; speed 40 ft.; Str 13, Dex 16, Con 14, Int 14, Wis 11, Cha 16; immune to charmed; darkvision 60 ft.; speaks Sylvan and understands your languages. It makes half the spell level rounded down Shortsword attacks for 1d6 + 3 + spell level piercing plus 1d6 force. As a bonus action Fey Step teleports it 30 feet, then Fuming grants advantage on its next attack that turn, Mirthful can charm one creature within 10 feet on a failed Wisdom save for up to 1 minute or until damaged, and Tricksy creates a 5-foot cube of magical darkness within 5 feet until the end of its next turn. Higher-level slots scale spell-level statistics.

wikidot5e:spell:summon-fiend.effectSummary: Summon a Large Fiendish Spirit in a visible unoccupied space within 90 feet for up to 1 hour, choosing Demon, Devil, or Yugoloth. It is your ally, shares your initiative and acts immediately after you, obeys verbal commands without your action, and otherwise Dodges and avoids danger. AC is 12 + spell level; HP 50 Demon, 40 Devil, or 60 Yugoloth plus 15 per spell level above 6th; speed 40 ft., with climb 40 Demon or fly 60 Devil; Str 13, Dex 16, Con 15, Int 10, Wis 10, Cha 16; fire resistance, poison immunity, poisoned immunity, darkvision 60 ft., and 60-foot telepathy. It has Magic Resistance. Demon explodes at 0 HP or spell end, forcing creatures within 10 feet to Dexterity-save against 2d10 + spell level fire, half on success, and uses a Bite for 1d12 + 3 + spell level necrotic. Devil sees through magical darkness and uses 150-foot Hurl Flame for 2d6 + 3 + spell level fire, igniting unattended flammable objects. Yugoloth uses Claws for 1d8 + 3 + spell level slashing and teleports 30 feet after each hit or miss. It makes half the spell level rounded down attacks. Higher-level slots scale spell-level statistics.

wikidot5e:spell:summon-greater-demon.effectSummary: Summon one demon of a chosen type with CR 5 or lower into a visible unoccupied space within 60 feet for up to 1 hour. It has its own initiative. When summoned and on each of your turns, you may issue a verbal command without using an action; without a command it attacks any creature within reach that attacked it. At the end of each of its turns it makes a Charisma save, with disadvantage if you speak its true name; on success you permanently lose control for the rest of the spell and it attacks the nearest non-demons. If concentration ends early after control is lost, it remains for 1d6 rounds if still alive. You may consume the blood component to draw a protective circle around your space that the demon cannot cross, harm, or target into while the spell lasts. Each slot level above 4th raises the maximum CR by 1.

wikidot5e:spell:summon-lesser-demons.effectSummary: Summon hostile demons into visible unoccupied spaces within 60 feet for up to 1 hour; roll 1d6 to determine the group: 1–2 summons two demons of CR 1 or lower, 3–4 summons four of CR 1/2 or lower, and 5–6 summons eight of CR 1/4 or lower. The DM chooses the demon types. They share an initiative group and attack the nearest non-demons, including you and your allies. You may consume the blood component to draw a protective circle around your space that the demons cannot cross, harm, or target into while the spell lasts. A 6th- or 7th-level slot doubles the number summoned; an 8th- or 9th-level slot triples it.
